name: WooqLaw
summary: Blazor interfaces backed by clear, maintainable APIs.
description: Full-stack feature development for a legal technology platform, combining a Blazor frontend with an ASP.NET Core backend. Contributions include reusable interface components and API retrieval improvements.
technologies: Blazor, ASP.NET Core, .NET 8 / .NET 9, REST APIs, SQL Server, Clean Architecture
challenge: Legal workflows need consistent interfaces and responsive data retrieval as features grow across the application.
approach: Build reusable Blazor components and improve backend retrieval paths while keeping responsibilities separated through Clean Architecture and SOLID principles.
imageAlt: Concept illustration of legal documents, balanced scales, and organised workflows for WooqLaw
